evidence.claim: SeatFlow, a seating chart maker app, sells a Lifetime unlock for $17.99 and a Weekly plan for $2.99 as in-app purchases.
PlanSeats charges $8.99 a month for its Planner plan and $50 one time for Planner Lifetime, with a free Starter tier.

A WeddingWire forum thread complains an update to its seating chart tool removed features like dragging whole parties and room and table size inputs, and the poster planned to use a different seating chart generator.
A WeddingWire forum thread active until July 2025 reports the seating planner only seats whole households and that guests disappeared from the planner.

title: Seatwise
oneLiner: Plan a wedding seating chart on your phone in minutes, private, no signup
customer: Couples and family members planning a wedding or large event seating
revenueModel: Free planner, one-time paid Pro unlock (price pending owner approval)
nextAction: Lead fixes the spec per the product review: record pre-order intent on the Pro page and count it in stats.json, add error-state tests (blank or zero tables, more guests than seats, oversized group), test every screen at 390, 820 and 1440 px, collect the event name for Print, add a zero-network-requests test. Then product re-review, code changes, engineer review, and the live check after ap-4

qaLocal.notes: Independent local QA: 15 of 15 acceptance tests pass; defects D1 to D7 fixed and re-tested. Live URL still to test.

lead.name: Ira
lead.trait: Founder energy. Talks to the problem before the solution.
